annotation.title_en: Organizational Rules of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's ministerial ordinance on the internal organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (current revision effective Oct 2026), defining bureaus, divisions and official posts. Only incidental AI-related posts appear (an AI utilization planning officer, an automated-driving technology examiner, and a construction automation planning officer).
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines the internal bureaus, divisions and posts of MLIT
Creates an AI utilization promotion planning officer in the Information Policy Division
Creates an automated driving technology examiner for vehicle type approval in the Logistics and Automobile Bureau
Creates a construction automation planning officer for construction machinery
Contains a cybersecurity office and a personal information protection function
